findings.actual_failure: With Git older than 2.39 or a changed spec directory, an adopted rebase classifies wording-only and no non-protected reviewer is asked.
findings.observation: A subject reached by an adopted reanchor that fails a rebase condition falls through to the delta check, whose path union is unchanged, so wording-only passes vacuously.

findings.actual_failure: A changed table cell, heading, or command inside a nested fence classifies wording-only.
findings.observation: The Markdown scan treats a pipe table without a leading pipe, a setext heading and its underline, and code after an inner shorter fence inside a longer fence as plain prose.

findings.actual_failure: review-cap can fire after zero repairs.
findings.observation: Round counting counts any subject whose product changed after a subject with open findings, including one reached only by an adopted reanchor.

findings.actual_failure: The AC-0002 read limit does not hold for the tree read.
findings.observation: The full-tree listing the classifier reads has no 1 MiB bound; in this repository it is 1,134,608 bytes.

findings.actual_failure: A stalled git process or a full stderr pipe blocks the supervisor indefinitely.
findings.observation: The bounded launch applies its timeout only after stdout reaches end of file and drains stderr last.

findings.actual_failure: The run is refused review-anchor-invalid permanently, and delivery/ cannot be repaired by the controller.
findings.observation: A path the run touched and restored yields an empty patch id, which anchor_record writes and parse_anchors then rejects on every read.

findings.actual_failure: Crafted repeated-line content can stall the supervisor for hours.
findings.observation: The classifier line diff uses difflib with autojunk off on worker-controlled content up to 1 MiB, with no time or line bound.

findings.actual_failure: On a case-insensitive host an instruction-loaded file can classify wording-only.
findings.observation: An @ reference that names a tree entry only under case folding, a fragment, or trailing markup counts as absent rather than reached.

findings.actual_failure: A stalled or chatty git process can block the supervisor.
findings.observation: The bounded launch has no whole-lifetime timeout, drains stderr last, writes stdin before draining, and lets BrokenPipeError escape.

findings.actual_failure: Code and contract disagree on symlink references.
findings.observation: An @ reference that resolves to a symlink is followed, while AC-0003 says it classifies full.

findings.actual_failure: A wrong disposition target passes the test.
findings.observation: The accept-risk flow test accepts either shared-id finding as the disposed one.

findings.actual_failure: AC-0002's limit does not hold and readiness does repeated full-tree reads.
findings.observation: Tree and rev-list reads are unbounded and repeat on every readiness call.

findings.actual_failure: An operator cannot tell from status why a lower tier was denied.
findings.observation: The tier reason is lost when rebase is refused, on git errors, and when anchor or run-base reads fail.

findings.actual_failure: Arms not driven by integration runs go unchecked.
findings.observation: review_flow bundles six responsibilities and its tier-to-roles mapping is testable only through the CLI harness.

findings.actual_failure: A field-mapping regression in production leaves unit tests green.
findings.observation: Production builds AnchorFacts inline while tests exercise latest_anchor.

findings.actual_failure: Changing one copy leaves the others stale.
findings.observation: The 1 MiB read limit is defined in three places.

findings.actual_failure: Extra parse; two counts from separate reads.
findings.observation: review_flow parses the decisions ledger twice per call.

findings.actual_failure: A changed code line after an indented inner fence classifies wording-only and excuses every non-protected reviewer.
findings.observation: A fence line indented four or more spaces closes the open fence, because the closing check runs on the stripped line; CommonMark allows at most three spaces.

findings.actual_failure: A file reached only from a Unicode-folded instruction name is not followed.
findings.observation: Instruction files are discovered with ASCII-only icase pathspecs while the name check folds Unicode.

findings.actual_failure: A regression of the line-diff bound would not turn the suite red.
findings.observation: The repetitive-file timing test passes with the bounded matcher reverted; the old matcher finishes the fixture in 1.16 s.

findings.actual_failure: Deleting either reason path leaves every suite green.
findings.observation: The Supervisor-Anchor-Skipped trailer and the run-base reason suffix are not tested through review_flow.

findings.actual_failure: A cut-short listing could hide an instruction file; no trigger traced.
findings.observation: The bounded launcher's drain swallows a stream read error and returns partial output as success.

findings.actual_failure: Renaming a local fails the test with no behaviour change.
findings.observation: A source-text assertion sits beside the behaviour check for the shared anchor builder.

findings.actual_failure: A regression shows as a CI timeout rather than a failure.
findings.observation: The launcher regression tests would hang, not fail, if the drain regressed.
